textList.text: Keywords: Uranium isotopes, redox proxies, Cenozoic marine redox introduction Models predict that warmer surface temperatures will reduce O2 solubility and potentially increase thermal stratiﬁcation in Earth’s oceans (Sarmiento and others, 1998; Shaffer and others, 2009), potentially leading to ocean “deoxygenation” on a broad scale (for examples, Keeling and others, 2010).
